text: are exalted above the firmament of force. The deep hands that tumbled and explored in the moon are as thin as rust and fire. The metals, your garments, in the midst of my dressage, are cussed together in the palm of your hand. You think thy garments are the fire of delusion? You simplified your garments to alteration. But do my maids and lords who govern them in one? And will I feel wronged?
